The '''1987–88 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], ten points ahead of [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]]. Due to a league contraction to ten teams [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]], [[Dunfermline Athletic F.C.|Dunfermline Athletic]] and [[Greenock Morton F.C.|Morton]] were relegated.
